Hi Maria —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 25-minute discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency on your nightly batch scoring pipeline and cut per-token cost for interactive dashboards.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent dataset, East US region required, and a 3rd-party key-management requirement for auditability.
- Success metric for pilot: 40% lower token cost or < 120ms p95 for the dashboard workloads.

Next steps we suggested on the call:
1) 30-minute product orientation (high-level runtime + cost levers) with two tech stakeholders (infra + ML infra).
2) Share a short checklist for security/compliance evidence we can assemble in parallel.

To make scheduling easy, proposed 3 windows (all times PT):
- Option A: Mon 13 Sep, 09:30–10:00 PT
- Option B: Tue 14 Sep, 11:00–11:30 PT
- Option C: Wed 15 Sep, 16:00–16:30 PT (we can make this earlier if needed)

Can you confirm which of the three works and who from Peregrine you want on the call (tech owner + backup)? I copied Ben (solutions engineer) to confirm attendee list on our side.

I attached a 1-page discovery summary and a suggested 30-minute agenda to make the session concrete.

Thanks —
